predecessorResult.description: Existing addressed run-detail/result path; no duplicate result store.

code.description: Machine-readable refusal code carried from the throwing gate; null when the failure had no typed code.

retryable.description: True when retry can replay this turn (a job was recorded before the failure); false when no job exists to replay or a managed resource it names was released.

required_actions.description: Bounded user actions that may make an exact retry succeed.

context.description: Bounded typed recovery context; never arbitrary provider or environment output.

problem.description: Typed, sanitized problem for a thread turn that could not start.

anyOf.description: Stable hold. Editing, observation and readiness restoration never rearm it; inspect the predecessor result and clear before an ordinary continuation. One exception: an unchanged settlement_unknown draft returns by itself when a later settlement of the predecessor's run, by the live daemon that ran it, proves its processes gone (see resumed); a Stop first keeps it held.

hold.description: Stable hold. Editing, observation and readiness restoration never rearm it; inspect the predecessor result and clear before an ordinary continuation. One exception: an unchanged settlement_unknown draft returns by itself when a later settlement of the predecessor's run, by the live daemon that ran it, proves its processes gone (see resumed); a Stop first keeps it held.

from.description: The hold the draft was returned from.

reason.description: A later settlement of the predecessor's run proved its processes gone; the draft was unchanged, not cleared, replaced or stopped.

resumed.description: Why this draft left its hold automatically. It then took the existing revision and admission path; any other reason holds it again.

resourceId.description: Immutable daemon resource id returned by upload finalize.

items.description: Reference to an immutable daemon-owned uploaded resource.

prompt.description: The user's prompt for the run.

instructions.description: System-level instructions layered onto every task-producing lane; delivered natively (append-system-prompt-file / developer_instructions) or as a delimited prompt prefix.

attachments.description: Immutable daemon resource ids returned by upload finalize; paths and inline bytes are not accepted.

mode.description: Canonical run mode: ask and plan are read-only, agent writes. Strategy controls are separate schema-owned fields, never modes.

taskGroupId.description: Caller-generated UUID saved before launching the first member. Each job still needs its own idempotency key; the group grants no execution authority.

root.description: Absolute path of the project root.

context.description: Project context depth; auto is the only mode.

ephemeral.description: Declare the root one-shot: it anchors this run only, is never entered into the durable project registry, and its commands/run events live in the global no-project partition.

scope.description: What the run operates on: a project (with root) or nothing.

isolation.description: Run isolation: envelope (isolated worktree in the external per-project runtime namespace, the default) or live (the project tree itself).

delegated.description: Marks a run driven by an EXTERNAL orchestrator that owns the workspace, not by the operator at a surface. Such a run uses a scoped harness HOME even under isolation='live' (an in-place delegated attempt therefore cannot resume a native vendor session stored under the real HOME). Unrelated to the `delegate` belt flag and to `delegatedFromRunId` (belt-child provenance).

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute existing execution workspace for a project-scoped delegated run: the live tree of an agent run (or the source of its directory execution), and the read-only tree of a delegated thread's Ask/Plan turn. The stable project identity remains scope.root.

workspaceKind.description: Explicit directory execution needs no Git initialization; omission preserves existing clients.

scopePaths.description: Agent-selected input footprint. Directory copies materialize this entire selection; direct runs need no whole-tree baseline.

auxiliaryWritableRoots.description: Exact existing absolute directories, created by the caller, that an Agent run with effective workspace_write may also write (service caches or scratch outside the execution tree). [] grants nothing extra; so does omission, except that a continueFrom successor omitting execution inherits its predecessor's whole execution group. Requires a lane whose capability_profile.access_control.auxiliary_writable_roots is true; the files are never part of the project result.

execution.description: Execution isolation and delegation settings for a run.

items.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

harnesses.description: Eligible harness pool for the run; omitted = engine auto-pools.

primaryHarness.description: Primary harness the run should prefer.

routingGoal.description: Routing objective: pace expiring quota, choose the highest declared quality tier, or minimize incremental paid spend.

model.description: Scalar model convenience: expands to the resolved primary harness only (never the pool); rejected with a multi-harness pool and no primary — use models instead.

models.description: Harness-scoped model map (harness id to model id); an entry here wins over the scalar model and over the per-harness settings default.

processingPreference.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

promptCacheTtl.description: Native prompt-cache lifetime for the main conversation and helper requests of a harness that declares it. Omission sends no override: native defaults, profile settings and the inherited environment stay in effect.

efforts.description: Harness-scoped effort map (harness id to effort); an entry here wins over the scalar effort and the per-harness settings default.

review.description: Agent model review: ordinary runs default off; true selects an automatic panel. Explicit reviewer controls, best-of and untilClean request review. Capped attempts default to review unless explicitly false.

reviewerModels.description: Per-provider-family reviewer model overrides (legacy; reviewerPanel wins when present).

reviewerEfforts.description: Per-provider-family reviewer effort overrides (legacy; reviewerPanel wins when present).

n.description: Race width: number of best-of-N candidates.

attempts.description: Cap on convergence attempts; null = engine default.

untilClean.description: Agent flag: iterate until the convergence predicate is clean (no fixed cap).

deepScan.description: Ask flag: bounded multi-scout research sweep with synthesis.

council.description: Plan strategy: N harnesses draft plans in parallel, the primary merges into one unified plan + one question set. Plan mode only.

synthesis.description: Best-of-N synthesis policy: auto only synthesizes an extra candidate when n>=3 and candidates genuinely complement; always/never force it.

paidBudget.description: Explicit incremental-cash budget for the run.

access.description: Requested access profile; effective access is derived by the engine and never client-supplied.

web.description: Web policy for the run (alias of externalContextPolicy; must match when both set).

externalContextPolicy.description: External web/context policy for the run.

browser.description: Request the agent-driven browser; preflight records per-lane effectiveness and refuses when no selected lane can receive it.

program.description: Executable invoked directly without an implicit shell.

args.description: Exact argv passed to the executable.

cwd.description: Optional project-relative working directory for the command.

envAllowlist.description: Non-secret parent environment names explicitly forwarded to the command.

items.description: Canonical deterministic command invocation; no implicit shell parsing.

tests.description: Typed-argv commands to run as deterministic gates.

path.description: Glob approved by the operator/user for this run; consumed only by the auto-protected gate/test path policy, not by built-in critical-path gates.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the approval.

items.description: Per-run typed operator approval allowing changes under an auto-protected gate/test path.

protectedPathApprovals.description: Typed per-run approvals for changing auto-protected gate/test paths; does not bypass built-in critical/security path human gates.

threadId.description: Thread this run is a turn of.

turnId.description: Internal daemon handoff only; rejected (400) when supplied by a client on POST /runs — use POST /threads/:id/turns instead.

parentRunId.description: Server-owned parent/follow-up lineage; rejected on direct POST /runs.

delegatedFromRunId.description: Internal belt-child provenance only; equals parentRunId and is rejected on direct POST /runs.

retryOf.description: Server-owned Exact Retry lineage; direct POST /runs rejects it.

continueFrom.description: Continue a terminal predecessor run owned by this daemon; one accepted successor per predecessor. Omitted mode, scope, execution, harness, model and promptCacheTtl come from the predecessor; prompt is the continuation text and may be empty.

continueCarrier.description: Carrier preference for continueFrom; omitted = auto.

continueModelInherited.description: Internal continuation model provenance; direct POST /runs rejects it.

planRunId.description: Internal daemon handoff only; rejected (400) on POST /runs. When set, the turn implements an approved plan from that run.

planRef.description: Internal daemon handoff only; rejected (400) on POST /runs. Frozen-plan reference delivered to the executor as a file.

harness.description: Explicit reviewer harness id; repeated harness ids are allowed so one provider can review through multiple requested models.

model.description: Per-reviewer model hint, passed to that harness only.

effort.description: Per-reviewer effort hint, passed to that harness only.

credentialProfileId.description: Per-reviewer credential profile id; explicit pins are strict and never fall back.

processingPreference.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

items.description: One reviewer of an explicit reviewer panel — a harness plus optional model, effort, and strict credentialProfileId. Compact entries are unpinned; structured JSON carries pins.

reviewerPanel.description: Explicit Agent reviewer panel — who reviews the change, one entry per reviewer as `harness=model:effort` (CLI `--reviewer-panel`, unpinned) or structured `--reviewer-panel-json` with optional strict credentialProfileId. Duplicate harness entries are kept so one provider can review through several models; overrides the legacy reviewerModels/reviewerEfforts maps.

credentialProfileId.description: Explicit per-run credential profile id; null FORCES the engine-default ladder past a thread-sticky profile; unknown/disabled ids refuse, never default.

delegate.description: Agent-only: inject the Claudexor delegation belt so the harness can spawn bounded isolated sub-runs; non-agent modes refuse, while known belt or harness unavailability degrades before start to ordinary Agent with a durable warning.

maxSeconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the whole run (seconds, max seven days). Omission disables the clock. Explicit limits cancel by default; soft mode warns and continues.

timeLimitMode.description: Initial timer mode: soft warns and continues; hard cancels. Omission is hard with maxSeconds and soft without it.

denyPaths.description: Per-run globs no candidate may touch at all; envelope-only (in-place runs are refused), enforced by the engine post-diff gate, disclosed per lane via path_deny receipts. accept_risk may still deliver (INV-111).

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the run's final answer; mandatory (incapable lane => preflight refusal), engine-validated into final/output.json with a typed outputConformance receipt.

default_model.description: Per-harness default model; null = the harness's own default, or no model on a route whose request must name one.

effort.description: Default reasoning effort for the harness; null = harness default.

max_turns.description: Default max agent turns; null = no limit.

max_rounds.description: Default max convergence rounds; null = engine default.

fallback_model.description: Model to fall back to on typed fallback signals; null = none.

web.description: Default web policy for this harness.

auth_preference.description: Preferred auth route: subscription (native/OAuth session), api_key (a stored API key), or auto (engine picks subscription-first with policy fallback). A preference, not a secret.

primaryHarness.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

anyOf.description: Request body for POST /runs: prompt, mode, scope, routing, strategy flags, budget, policies, and thread linkage.

capturedStart.description: Immutable execution controls captured once; null after clear. Completed envelopes may continue in a different_root under ordinary continueFrom custody.

capturedAt.description: When capturedStart was frozen: draft creation. Edits never recapture; null after clear.

DeferredMessageDetail.description: Compact addressed draft state, with exact predecessor result and successor handles. A terminal predecessor does not imply the draft has resolved.
